project_list.name: Toyota x SMN: Secret Road Trip
project_list.description: Full page design developed for a large campaign with Toyota and Secret Media. Built from scratch outside the standard template using Astro and Svelte, translating Figma designs into a fully custom experience. Integrated complex Google Maps functionality with dynamic routes and markers, leveraging Svelte state management and local storage to deliver an interactive hidden gems journey.
